verses.text: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
lines: Praise Yah!
Praise Yahweh’s name!
Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

verses.text: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
lines: you who stand in Yahweh’s house,
in the courts of our God’s house.

verses.text: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.
lines: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good.
Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

verses.text: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.
lines: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself,
Israel for his own possession.

verses.text: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.
lines: For I know that Yahweh is great,
that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.text: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
lines: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done,
in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

verses.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.
lines: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth.
He makes lightnings with the rain.
He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.text: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
lines: He struck the firstborn of Egypt,
both of man and animal.

verses.text: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
lines: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt,
on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

verses.text: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
lines: He struck many nations,
and killed mighty kings,

verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
lines: Sihon king of the Amorites,
Og king of Bashan,
and all the kingdoms of Canaan,

verses.text: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.
lines: and gave their land for a heritage,
a heritage to Israel, his people.

verses.text: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
lines: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever;
your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

verses.text: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
lines: For Yahweh will judge his people
and have compassion on his servants.

verses.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
lines: The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
the work of men’s hands.

verses.text: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.
lines: They have mouths, but they can’t speak.
They have eyes, but they can’t see.

verses.text: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.
lines: They have ears, but they can’t hear,
neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.text: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.
lines: Those who make them will be like them,
yes, everyone who trusts in them.

verses.text: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
lines: House of Israel, praise Yahweh!
House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

verses.text: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
lines: House of Levi, praise Yahweh!
You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

verses.text: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
lines: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion,
who dwells at Jerusalem.
Praise Yah!
